# تَكَوْفَدْتَ (takawfadta) /ta.kaw.fad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# تَكَوْفَدْتِ (takawfadti) /ta.kaw.fad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# تَكَوْفَدَتْ (takawfadat) /ta.kaw.fa.dat/: t
